speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are here complaining of weakness and decreased sensation in your right arm; to help narrow down the cause, please describe exactly when these symptoms started and if they came on suddenly or gradually. speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Peripheral Neuropathy (likely diabetic) or Cervical Radiculopathy; however, given the weight loss, steroid use, and age, Paraneoplastic Syndrome or Metastatic Disease must be ruled out.
REQUEST TEST: HbA1c, CBC, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Tumor Markers.
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Cervical Spine.
